subject: Clearmont Retail — urgent: latency & error-rate spike, routing failover request
messages:
From: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@clearmont.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: support@clearmont.ai
Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: sudden latency & 5xx spike in us-west-2 (Clearmont Production)

Jordan —

We started seeing a sharp increase in end-user page load latency around 08:50 PT and about 0.7% 5xx errors on our checkout traffic since then. Errors are concentrated in us-west-2 and only for requests routed through your west edge. Downtime is not total but our conversion rate is dropping. Our ops team attached a quick error snapshot and a tail of latency traces.

Can Redwood switch routing to the alternative region immediately? Our customers are on a tight Black Friday lead-up and this is high-severity for us.

Thanks,
Ari Kaplan
Head of Infrastructure, Clearmont Retail

Attachments: clearmont-1102-error-snaps.zip
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@clearmont.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: sudden latency & 5xx spike in us-west-2 (Clearmont Production)

Ari — thanks for flagging and for the attachment. I’m escalating immediately. I’ve looped in ops and routing.

Quick plan:
- Soojin, can you confirm whether the spike correlates with a node-level signal or routing policy?
- Vanessa, I’d like approval to run a regional steer (us-west-2 -> us-west-1) for Clearmont if we see continued error rate above 0.5% for 10 minutes.
- Marissa, I’m copying you for exec visibility; if this lasts >60m we’ll need an executive customer update and a temporary credit offer.

I’ll keep you posted every 15 minutes.

—Jordan
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: sudden latency & 5xx spike in us-west-2 (Clearmont Production)

Jordan / Vanessa — quick triage update from runtime:
- At 08:48 PT we observed a 3x surge in queue depth for the west-edge LBs serving us-west-2. Token-processing latency for 8k request window increased ~180ms p50 -> 420ms p50 and p95 jumped to ~1.4s.
- Root cause: transient kernel-level preemption on a subset of GPU hosts + elevated tail latencies in the KV cache invalidation path. Not a customer-side load pattern.
- Affected model variant: r-instruct-13b-q4f. Fallback model variant (13b-quantized-compat) shows normal latency but lower throughput — will increase unit cost if used at scale.

Immediate ask: permission to enact routing policy to steer Clearmont traffic to us-west-1 with gradual 25% increments over 10 minutes (monitoring) OR swap to fallback model for the west-edge pool (faster to execute, higher cost).

I recommend routing steer first to preserve output quality.

Soojin
SRE — Serving Runtime
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: sudden latency & 5xx spike in us-west-2 (Clearmont Production)

Approve gradual routing steer to us-west-1 for Clearmont now. Conditions: 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 10-minute checks, rollback if 5xx > 0.6% post-commit or if downstream agrees this introduces unacceptable latency. Communicate to Clearmont ops immediately with clear ETA and rollback triggers.

Also request SRE snapshot and a short incident note for post-mortem. Marissa, please prep an executive note we can send to Ari if this extends beyond 45 minutes.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Reliability
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@clearmont.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Clearmont — routing change initiated and exec update

Ari — following Jordan’s escalation we have initiated a controlled regional steer of Clearmont traffic from us-west-2 to us-west-1. Current status: 25% -> 50% completed. Monitoring shows error rate trending down to 0.18% and p95 latency improving toward baseline.

What we’re doing next:
- Complete 100% steer if metrics remain stable at the next 10-minute check (expected by 10:15 PT).
- Post-incident: full SRE write-up, list of root causes (KV cache invalidation + host preemption), and mitigation plan (kernel patch scheduling, improved host-side backpressure).
- As a gesture for the disruption window we’ll offer a one-time service credit tied to the BlkFri readiness program; Jordan will follow up on details.

We will keep you posted.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-failover-playbook-v3.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@clearmont.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Post-incident summary: Clearmont us-west-2: latency & error-rate spike (final)

Hi Ari —

Final update and next steps from Redwood: the routing steer to us-west-1 completed and Clearmont traffic is stable. Key facts:
- Incident window: 08:48–10:12 PT (approx).
- Impact: p95 latency increased up to 1.4s at peak; error rate peaked ~0.75% concentrated in us-west-2.
- Root cause (provisional): subset of GPU hosts experienced kernel-level preemption causing KV cache invalidations and sustained tail latency.
- Immediate mitigations: controlled regional steer (us-west-2 -> us-west-1), SRE hotfix schedule for host preemption guard, and temporary model fallback patterns for critical routes.

Next actions for Redwood (owner in parentheses):
- Host kernel patch scheduling and capacity rebalancing (SRE: Soojin) — target 11/04
- Post-mortem with timeline and mitigations (Reliability: David Kim) — draft 11/03
- Customer credit and readiness routing consult (CS: Marissa / Jordan) — customer proposal by 11/03

We apologize for the disruption and will share the post-mortem and actions publicly to Clearmont’s ops mailbox. If you prefer a live bridge for the post-mortem, we can schedule one tomorrow morning.

—Rishi Malhotra
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference
